_comment: bb-ldo P2 merged constraint set (architect). Prose, citations and the conflicts resolved: architecture/blocks.md, architecture/power_tree.md, architecture/stackup.md, architecture/sheets.md. Sources merged: research/power.json (power + thermal), research/linear-regulator.json (part class), research/refdesign-linear-regulator.json (tab identity, ESR window, copper sweep). Canonical net names: +5V, +3V3, GND - all three are global power symbols, there are no local-label nets on this board.

power._basis: 510 mA pass current + 5 mA ASSUMED quiescent (research/power.md s.2). 0.26 mm min width at 1 oz outer / dT 10 C - no width on this board is tight
500 mA owner-stated continuous load + 10 mA contingent min-load bleed
power._plane_fed_why: the rail's trunk IS the F.Cu thermal pour; plane_fed also makes check_current error plane_missing if that pour is ever absent - the only gate that can enforce the existence of the thermal design at P7

power._basis: return of the +5V budget; B.Cu pour
power._pdn_false_why: GND is a return, not a rail - check_pdn inventories every power entry and would error 'no decoupling' on it

thermal._power_basis: 0.975 W conduction ((5.25 - 3.3) x 0.500) + 0.026 W quiescent (5.25 V x 5 mA ASSUMED) = 1.00 W frozen design point; stacked worst-case corner 1.10 W
thermal._dt_basis: Ta 50 C still air, Tj target 115 C = 10 C under the 125 C steady-state limit -> allowed rise 65 C -> theta_JA <= 65 C/W at 1.00 W. Kept HONEST: check_thermal's 2-layer model floors at 73.8 C/W and will report thermal_area at P8 for any layout - to be waived at P8 with the two vendor copper sweeps as evidence, never softened to make a gate green
thermal._net_is_tab: SOT-223 tab = VOUT, NOT GND. The heatsink pour is the +3V3 net and cannot be via-stitched to a bottom GND pour
thermal._min_vias_why: ZERO thermal vias, deliberately - was 12, corrected at P4 on a schematic-reviewer finding. The tab pour is the +3V3 net and B.Cu is a continuous GND plane, so there is nothing on the far side for a stitching via to land on: a via from this pour to GND is a SHORT, not a heat path (verified record linear-regulator-live-tab-thermal-vias). Requiring 12 vias would have forced either an illegal stitch or a bottom-side +3V3 island that punches a hole in the GND return under the hottest part of the board. The record's own prescription for 2 layers with a GND bottom is exactly this: a large top-side VOUT pour, the ground plane CONTINUOUS underneath it, and NO vias through it - the far-side copper still works, coupled through the FR-4 dielectric (AMS1117 p5), which is worth ~5 C/W at 1000 mm2. The 12-via figure was inherited from exposed-pad-to-GND practice, where it is correct and here is not

sides.reason: the F.Cu +3V3 pour IS the heatsink and the tab must sit on it; JLC economy assembly is single-sided SMT
single-sided SMT assembly; Cin must be at the VIN pin with a short lead
single-sided SMT assembly; compensation cap at VOUT
through-hole screw terminal - wires and screwdriver enter from the component side
through-hole screw terminal - wires and screwdriver enter from the component side

blocks.name: U1 AMS1117-3.3 class fixed 3.3 V linear regulator, SOT-223, tab = VOUT
blocks._dims_why: vin_v/vin_min_v/vin_max_v: dissipation scales with the high-line corner, dropout headroom with the low-line one. iout_a 0.51 = 500 mA owner load + 10 mA contingent bleed. pdiss_w/ta_c/board_layers/copper_oz: every theta_JA rule in this domain is stated against a copper area on a layer count at a copper weight, at an ambient. pass_device_kind bipolar-npn and cout_stability_kind esr-dependent are the two tokens that bound almost every 1117-class rule (a CMOS/ceramic-stable LDO reuses this library with pass_device_kind cmos / cout_stability_kind ceramic-stable and correctly stops matching them). tab_net_kind vout says the heatsink pour cannot be stitched to GND (tab_net_kind gnd re-enables that whole family of records). dropout_kind standard bounds the headroom rules (low-dropout for a true LDO); adjust_kind fixed bounds the ADJ-divider/CADJ rules; cooling_kind natural-convection bounds every still-air theta_JA number.
